{{Top}}
[[File:Fire_extinguisher.png|thumb|250px|R2-D2 putting out a fire on the ''Millennium Falcon'']]
A '''fire extinguisher''', sometimes known as a '''flame douser'''<ref name="TFAD">{{JournalCite|6|To Fight Another Day}}</ref> was a tool used to put out fires with the use of some sort of fire-retardant material, such as [[halon]].<ref name="Breakout">{{WEGCite|story=Rebel Breakout|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref> [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droids]] including the [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2]] and [[R5-series astromech droid|R5-series]] were fitted with fire extinguishers as part of their standard equipment loadout.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], after escaping from the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] put out a small fire that was started on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] after it took several hits from pursuing [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]].<ref name="IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref> A few years later, he again made use of his built-in extinguisher while on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. This time it was used as a smokescreen to blind the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] that were chasing them.<ref name="V">{{Film|V}}</ref>
